svg.title: Connection technique
svg.text: 1. Each chord well built: ranges, spacing, third present, leading tone not doubled, VII complete
2. Each voice with allowed intervals · the common tone may stay
3. Six pairs of voices: no parallel or contrary 5ths or octaves
4. No simultaneous leaps in the same direction (except two perfect 4ths)
5. Leading tone in the soprano → rises to the tonic (except III–IV)
